articles.title: Save $500 Off the Powerful Skytech Ryzen X3D GeForce RTX 5070 Prebuilt Gaming PC at Walmart
articles.summary: Walmart has a better deal than Amazon on a prebuilt PC that excels at 1440p gaming. The Skytech Harpy gaming PC with AMD Ryzen X3D CPU and GeForce RTX 5070 GPU has dropped to $1,799 with free shipping after a $500 off discount.
body: The Skytech Harpy gaming PC is equipped with a liquid cooled AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D CPU, GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GPU, 32GB of DDR5-6000MHz RAM, and a 1TB M.2 SSD.

The AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D is an 8-core, 16-thread CPU with a boost clock of 5GHz. Although it has been succeeded by the newer 9000X3D series of processors, the AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D still maintains its reputation as an all-star gaming CPU. The secret to its gaming performance is the inclusion of 3D-V-Cache technology, which is only found in the X3D CPUs. According to Passmark, the 7800X3D's gaming performance surpasses that of the newer Intel Core Ultra 7 265K. The 7800X3D also consumes less power and produces less heat than the 9800X3D. Temps are effectively managed by a robust 360mm all-in-one liquid cooling system.

articles.title: Bit Reactor CEO Welcomes Return of Some Furloughed Staff for 'Continued Support' of Star Wars Zero Company
articles.summary: Bit Reactor, the developer of Star Wars Zero Company, has begun returning some of its staff to the team after furloughing an estimated 80% of employees just before the game’s launch.
body: Bit Reactor’s CEO Greg Foertsch revealed the news in a public post on October 7, where he explained that the furloughs were necessary to “help us eventually bring as many people back as possible.”

Foertsh said that bringing these staff members back to Bit Reactor was an “important step forward” in the studio’s “continued support for Zero Company,” and that the team looks forward to sharing more updates about the game “soon.”

“Having to ask team members to step away after we navigated unexpected business developments outside of our control and so close to launch was an incredibly difficult decision,” Foertsh wrote. “...This team means a tremendous amount to me, and I am incredibly proud of what we have accomplished together. Thank you to our fans for the incredible response to the game and for supporting us along this journey.”

Sources with information about the situation told GameFile that the number of Bit Reactor’s payrolled staff now account for “more than half of what it had been ahead of the furloughs,” meaning that there is still a sizeable chunk of furloughed staff who aren’t getting paid.

articles.title: Controversial Horror Series Ropes Me Back In With Silent Hill’s Original Composer And Lady Dimitrescu
articles.summary: The Remothered games are true cult classics in the way that players find them either insufferable or inspired. As a lover of developer Stormind Games' antique perversions, but also a hater of its convoluted storytelling, I regretfully exist somewhere in between.
body: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy latest trailer, which premiered today during the latest Horror Game Awards showcase, revels in the weathered stone buildings and marble fountain angels of the game's Sicilian setting. Stormind Games' developers are based in Sicily themselves, so recreating the decaying decadence of the island for Red Nun's Legacy was like trying to catch a dream right upon waking: You may never remember every detail, but you know the smells and feelings perfectly, because you lived through them.

A statement to press explains, "The Sicily that Stormind Games recreated in Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy is the Sicily the team has always lived, seen, breathed. This trailer is a visual journey through the real places, textures, colors, and cultural details that shaped the world of Red Nun's Legacy, stemming directly from the memories of those who developed it."

It looks as gorgeous and imposing as a ballet school built by Dario Argento. But so did the original 2018 Remothered game Tormented Fathers and its 2020 sequel Broken Porcelain, and I don't love them as much as I wanted to.
points: The Remothered games are true cult classics in the way that players find them either insufferable or inspired.
As a lover of developer Stormind Games' antique perversions, but also a hater of its convoluted storytelling, I regretfully exist somewhere in between.

articles.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Manga Is on Sale at Amazon Today
articles.summary: Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days sale is coming to an end tonight, but there are still a few new deals to be had today. The online retailer has added various Legend of Zelda books to its '3 for 2' sale, including the official Ocarina of Time manga.
body: Akira Himeka's Legend of Zelda manga series is a great read any fan of the franchise will enjoy, and this sale makes it a great time to grab a physical copy of the Legendary Edition. With the Ocarina of Time remake on the horizon, it's a cool way to refamiliarize yourself with the story in a totally different format.

The Ocarina of Time is the only Legendary Edition included in Amazon's sale, but there are several other Zelda books you can buy with it. There's the awesome Art & Artifacts encyclopedia, which is an awesome Legend of Zelda gift idea for most fans. You can also grab several volumes of Himeka's Twilight Princess manga with the '3 for 2' promo attached.

If you're less interested in savings and just like the idea of owning some cool Legend of Zelda manga, there's also a Legendary Edition Box set available that is actually a chest. It's currently discounted on Amazon as well, but far from the lowest price we've seen on it. Still, for less than $100 you can get a Hylian chest filled with Legend of Zelda lore.

articles.title: Three Years Later, The Outlast Trials Just Smashed Its Concurrent-Player Record
articles.summary: The Outlast Trials, Red Barrels' co-op horror game set in its wider Outlast universe, just broke its concurrent-player record, eclipsing 120,000 players. The previous high came when the game launched in Steam Early Access in 2023 and the player count climbed to 36,000.
body: Today's new record means the indie horror game reset the bar with a total more than four times higher than its previous best.

Red Barrels credited a few big factors for the record. For one, The Outlast Trials is enjoying a huge discount in the Steam Autumn Sale, on sale for $4--though that sale ends tomorrow (Thursday, October 8), if you're interested.

The studio also revealed that roughly half of the players contributing to that total are from China, as the game is seeing a surge in popularity there. Naturally, the Halloween season helps too, even though it's not one of the new horror games coming out this month.

The Outlast Trials made its version 1.0 debut in the spring of 2024. Though it's playable solo, it's intended to be experienced as a co-op game for up to four people. Seasonal content and events have come to the game regularly since then, adding new villains, abilities, maps, and more.

articles.title: Resident Evil Movie Will Become Zach Cregger’s Biggest Ever, Surpassing Weapons
articles.summary: Zach Cregger has another hit on his hands with Resident Evil, and it's set to become his biggest movie ever by revenue at the box office. According to Deadline, Resident Evil is expected to surpass his current biggest movie, Weapons ($270 million worldwide), by the end of this week or sooner.
body: What's propelling Resident Evil higher was its release in China this week--it debuted there on October 5, and it's expected to make $35 million in China for its first week. If this comes to fruition, Resident Evil should pass $280 million globally this week.

The previous Resident Evil movies from director Paul W.S. Anderson also performed phenomenally in China. The last one, 2016's The Final Chapter, made $159.5 million in China alone, making up more than 51% of the movie's worldwide gross of $312.2 million. It's the highest-grossing Resident Evil movie ever. Cregger's Resident Evil still has work to do to catch up.
Cregger's earlier movie, 2022's Barbarian, made $46 million worldwide. Long before that, Cregger made Miss March, and it earned $4.6 million worldwide.
In terms of all video game movies, Resident Evil ranks No. 17, but if it does indeed reach $280 million, it will pass 2018's Tomb Raider ($274.6 million worldwide).

articles.title: 'Obsession' Officially Returning to Theaters As It's Never Been Seen Before
articles.summary: Curry Barker's hit horror movie Obsession is returning to theaters in 4DX on Oct. 14 for a deluxe and immersive special rerelease.
body: It appears that Obsession ’s phenomenal theatrical run has one final stop.

The horror film is returning to theaters for a single day in October, just in time for Halloween season. However, there’s a big difference this time around: Theater chain Regal Cinemas is showing the movie in 4DX. “You wished for this. Obsession back in theaters in 4DX one day only,” an Instagram post announcing the news reads. Tickets for the rerelease are available now.

For those who’ve never heard of 4DX, it’s a film format that uses motion seats, wind, fog, strobe lights, scents, water sprays, and more to “immerse” the viewer in the film. If that sounds over-the-top and a bit ridiculous, it very much is. The format recently went viral alongside The Odyssey ’s excellent theatrical run, which prompted audiences to think about different movie formats, like 70mm IMAX.

articles.title: What’s Next For Halo Under Activision? Probably Not The Endless
articles.summary: What likely would have been the big new enemy faction of the Halo universe, the Endless, have been fully revealed, though it's unclear what role, if any, they will play going forward.
body: As announced last month by Xbox's Matt Booty, Halo is under new management, with the responsibility of the next game in the series going to a completely new team under Activision. Halo Studios, formerly 343 Industries, will remain as a small team to oversee already-released titles like the recent Halo: Campaign Evolved. However, the majority of the studio, 268 people, have been laid off.

In the wake of the news, the latest (and now last) issue of the lore-focused Canon Fodder blog written by Halo Studios community writer Alex Wakeford has now become a parting gift from the studio to the community. In it, Wakeford reveals a glimpse at what the future of Halo might have looked like under Halo Studios' continued stewardship.

There are plenty of reveals within, including a look at Zeta Halo environments that may have at one time been planned for Halo Infinite DLC. But the biggest reveal is saved for last: an image that is the community's first full look at the Endless. This new enemy faction was teased in Halo Infinite via the Harbinger, a member of an advanced race that was imprisoned by the Forerunners on Zeta Halo due to their ability to survive the firing of the Halo rings.
points: What likely would have been the big new enemy faction of the Halo universe, the Endless, have been fully revealed, though it's unclear what role, if any, they will play going forward.

articles.title: 3 Stunning 25-Year-Old Pokémon Promo Cards Fetch Nearly $1.2 Million at Auction
articles.summary: There is no shortage of stunning high-end graded Pokémon TCG cards setting records weekly on the secondary market. Sometimes, though, a collection of cards comes along that deserves special plaudits due to historical significance, tremendous scarcity, or sheer aesthetic beauty.
body: Southern Islands was an unusual release from the beginning. The collection first appeared in Japan in 1999 alongside the second Pokémon movie, with its 18 cards divided between themed Tropical Island and Rainbow Island portfolios. Smaller three-card sets were also released, each focusing on a particular area of one of the two islands and forming a larger panoramic scene when placed together.

That interconnected artwork is a huge part of Southern Islands’ enduring appeal. Prolific Pokémon TCG illustrator Naoyo Kimura illustrated the Tropical Island scenes, while Keiko Fukuyama handled Rainbow Island, with each individual card essentially serving as one piece of a much larger picture.

articles.title: KPop Demon Hunters Gets An Official New Format Release Next Month
articles.summary: Netflix's breakout animated feature KPop Demon Hunters has been an unqualified streaming hit, with more than 1 billion hours viewed and a yearlong record-setting streak on the streaming service's top 10 charts.
body: But Netflix has another offline KPop Demon Hunters release coming in November that's unlike anything the streamer has done before. Netflix has teamed up with Penguin Random House to give Rumi, Mira, and Zoey a special boxed set comic that reimagines the animated movie in a totally new way.

KPop Demon Hunters: The Official Screen Comic Boxed Set is a 704-page, two-volume graphic novel that presents the movie as a full-color comic. Netflix and Penguin Random House's new book takes frames from the animated movie and lays them out like comic book panels, with speech bubbles and sound effects. Yes, they'll be missing out on the dynamic animation and catchy K-pop tunes, but KPop Demon Hunters fans who want to obsess over every frame and panel will soon be able to do so at their own pace.

Song-wise, KPop Demon Hunters: The Official Screen Comic Boxed Set includes song lyrics from the full soundtrack, including the "Hunter’s Mantra" and "Jinu’s Lament." The deluxe set features a holographic foil slipcase, two paperback volumes, each with foil-stamped book covers, and a spine design that highlights Rumi's two sides. Foldout posters of Huntr/x and their rivals the Saja Boys are also included.

articles.title: Sony is reportedly plotting to revive classic PlayStation games, starting with a new Ape Escape from the developers behind Sonic Mania
articles.summary: Sony reportedly wants to revive a selection of its long-dormant PlayStation classics with the help of smaller third-party developers, and a new Ape Escape game is apparently up first.
body: The tidbit comes courtesy of The Jeff Gerstmann podcast, where Gerstmann said that a new Ape Escape was on the way from Evening Star, the independent team who made the fan-favorite Sonic Mania before forming their own studio and releasing the surprisingly delightful Penny's Big Breakaway. VGC corroborated the podcast's claims, as well.

"I don't think this game is close to being out or anything like that, but I guess it's been almost a year since we started talking about Ape Escape," Gerstmann said. "Who is making it? That's a good question. My understanding is that it’s an external studio. You know, because people were immediately like, 'Oh, Team Asobi ( Astro Bot ) is making it.' My understanding is that an external team has been working on that… Evening Star. I heard that they were working on it."

VGC also reported that PlayStation isn't stopping with Ape Escape, either - the console maker is apparently keen to work with other outside developers on some of its legacy IP. It's the same blueprint Sony used for 2025's Everybody's Golf: Hot Shots, which was handled by Bandai Namco.

articles.title: FF7 Revelation Sets Up a Rude Awakening for Cloud
articles.summary: During a roughly 40-minute hands-on demo of the game’s first chapter on a PlayStation 5 Pro, I ventured into the Northern Crater, took the newly playable Cid and Vincent for a spin, and watched Cloud tiptoe right up to the brink of collapse.
body: By breaking the original story of Final Fantasy 7 into three parts, the team behind Square Enix’s ambitious remake trilogy created a challenge for themselves. Remake has the iconic reactor bombing mission to kick things off, but how do you recreate that magic three times over? Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth opens with a dread-inducing sequence detailing the Nibelheim incident five years earlier. Now, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation takes a similar, though more rapid-fire approach, steering headlong into Cloud’s fractured mental state at the end of Rebirth.

From what I can tell, Revelation picks up very soon after Rebirth leaves off, with Cloud and company departing the City of the Ancients to pursue Sephiroth at the Northern Crater. As the party ventures deeper, they begin to feel the intoxicating effects of all the Mako energy in the area (it’s like the Force, but also magic soul petroleum). Barret and Cid comment that they’re feeling tipsy. Yuffie wants to go home to Wutai, fearing an imminent Shinra invasion. All the while, Tifa continues to unconvincingly ignore Cloud’s rapid deterioration, for her own sake as much as his.

articles.title: Blizzard promises to make the blue elves in World of Warcraft: Forever look worse (positive)
articles.summary: A tension that will never go away as long as World of Warcraft: Forever exists is how true it is to the 2004 MMO. Blizzard signed up for this by creating an MMO that is trying to blend the old with the new so that anyone, regardless of their experience with WoW, can get into it.
body: That tension has been at its highest concentration with the new blue elves it debuted with WoW: Forever. The Skyborne have never existed in WoW before; they look almost exactly like the Blood Elves from The Burning Crusade expansion, but their lore tells us they're a faction of High Elves.

Some players love the twist on a race they've been asking to play for years, while others believe they tarnish the authenticity of an MMO that's trying to recreate the joys of playing the oldest era of the MMO. Even though the debate over the Skyborne will probably never be resolved, most players agreed that, at the very least, they looked way too new alongside WoW's crunchy old player models.

Blizzard said it would respond to the feedback about the Skyborne visuals before WoW: Forever launches in November and today it has done just that in a blog post promising to give them a retro makeover.

"Over the course of development, we have been aligning on the right range of fidelity and what feels like it belongs in the WoW: Forever world and what does not," Blizzard writes. "The team has learned much in the process, and that will continue to strengthen more with future content."
points: A tension that will never go away as long as World of Warcraft: Forever exists is how true it is to the 2004 MMO.

articles.title: Blood Bowl 3 is being replaced by Warhammer Blood Bowl: What will happen to everyone's unspent currency?
articles.summary: What happened. Blood Bowl 3, the latest videogame iteration of Games Workshop's tabletop game of literal fantasy football, has an in-game store where a currency called Warpstone can be spent on cosmetics and new teams.
body: I reached out to clarify the situation, and a Slitherine representative answered my questions. Here's the most important part: "Players will use the same BB account on both games, so they will instantly get all cosmetics, warpstones and teams they bought in BB3, into WH BB".

But while you don't need to spend your Warpstone out of fear any leftovers will be lost, if you've got enough to splash out on a team that might be worthwhile. The representative confirmed that Warhammer Blood Bowl will still have Warpstone as a way of buying cosmetics but said, "We are still thinking about how to handle Teams." Could we be going back to the Blood Bowl 2 situation where additional teams were sold as DLC?

The Warhammer Blood Bowl beta is currently being playtested, and if you want in you can click the "Request Access" button on its Steam page. I had an early go and found it a definite improvement, both for quality-of-life changes like the option to save and quit mid-match, and the new seven-a-side Rumble Mode if you like a smaller game. Also there's an icon in the UI you can mouse over to see the effects of current weather conditions, which is a tiny change but a welcome one.

videos.title: BrokenLore: Ascend - Release Date Trailer | PS5 Games
videos.summary: BrokenLore: Ascend launches on PS5® on January 7, 2027.
body: Climb to terrifying heights in a first-person psychological horror experience blending extreme climbing with supernatural horror inspired by the Rokurokubi, a terrifying yokai from Japanese folklore.
Follow two streamers as they attempt to climb a massive tower from the BrokenLore universe, officially created under license from Tokyo Tower.

videos.title: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
videos.summary: Play Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed now on Nintendo Switch 2:
body: Ravaged by a mysterious villain and his terrifying goons, the fate of the world rests in the hands of one character—Epic Mickey!

On Nintendo Switch 2, the adventure shines brighter than ever with higher resolution visuals, improved framerate, and mouse-style controls using the Joy Con 2. Players also receive a free Costume Pack DLC!
Unleash the power of the brush on the go with Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed.
